name: Yapily API
description:
The Yapily API enables connections between your application and users' banks. For more information check out our [documentation](https://docs.yapily.com/).

In particular, make sure to view our [Getting Started](https://docs.yapily.com/pages/home/getting-started/) steps if this is your first time here.

While testing the API, our list of [sandbox credentials](https://docs.yapily.com/pages/key-concepts/sandbox-credentials/) maybe useful.
